advisory.finding: The default close path cannot annotate any rebar ticket: `ancestor_atomic_submit` calls `closer(member_id)` where `member_id` is a Gerrit change id (from `WipChain.chain_member_ids`), but `close_ticket_via_rebar` treats it as a rebar ticket id (`tid = ticket_id or change_id`; `rebar.comment(tid, msg)`). `rebar.comment` -> `require_id` raises `CommandError('ticket "Ird" not found')` for a Gerrit change id, which the broad `except Exception` swallows to stderr — so on merge the production default never annotates the associated ticket.
scenarios: Any successful merge on the production default path where `close_ticket` is not injected: the ticket is never annotated; only an AUTOLANDER_ERROR line is written.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] On a partial land, perform the real Gerrit hand-back (remove Autosubmit + comment), not only the S3 marker — or document explicitly why only the marker is written and who removes the votes.

ABSENCE: no `client.set_review(..., labels={"Autosubmit": 0})` on the partial-land path
advisory.finding: On a partial land, `ancestor_atomic_submit` only invokes `record_handback` (the S3 marker writer) and never calls `hand_back()`, so the stack's `Autosubmit` votes are not removed and no Gerrit hand-back comment is posted — unlike `drive_to_submit`, which calls `hand_back(...)`. The AC requires handing the stack back via the S2b mechanism.
scenarios: Partial land: some members MERGED, one left NEW. The still-open member keeps its Autosubmit +1 and gets no hand-back comment, so the next poll may re-select it.
